command:
set -euo pipefail
cd /home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/visual
echo HOST=$(hostname)
echo DAEMON_SHA=$(sha256sum buehne_daemon.py | awk '{print $1}')
echo SERVICE=$(systemctl --user is-active frankenstein-buehne.service || true)
echo '=== MAIN ==='
pgrep -af '^/opt/google/chrome/chrome --app=http://127\.0\.0\.1:8788/' || true
echo '=== GPU ==='
pgrep -af '^/opt/google/chrome/chrome --type=gpu-process' || true
echo '=== RENDERERS ==='
pgrep -af '^/opt/google/chrome/chrome --type=renderer' | head -12 || true
echo '=== HTTP ==='
curl -fsS -o /dev/null -w 'HTTP=%{http_code}\n' http://127.0.0.1:8788/ || true
echo '=== BACKUPS ==='
sha256sum buehne_daemon.py.go-gpu-backup-20260912T0708 buehne_daemon.py.go-gpu-v3-backup-20260912T0714 2>/dev/null || true
